notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.5_2
notes.content:
[p]This is the most ambitious and heartfelt game we've ever created, and throughout development, we faced many challenges. As an indie team working on a game packed with new and risky features, there were many things we simply couldn't anticipate. We also lacked the experience to accurately predict a solid release date.[/p][p][/p][p]Even though there were still potential bugs, we decided not to delay the release any further after already missing our promised launch date twice. At that point, many fans were urging us to release the game quickly, even though we personally wanted a bit more time to test the closed beta more thoroughly.[/p][p][/p][p]Still, we didn’t want to let the community down, so we made the tough decision to release and collect feedback to fix and improve the game over time. [b]Right now, the game is in a fairly stable state.[/b] The early stages might feel a bit slow, but we hope you'll be patient. Once you get the hang of it, we believe you'll really enjoy it and feel the passion and care we've poured into every part of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re committed to continuing to improve the experience based on your feedback.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/18906d5b46af930fb2ef98eefe2ebddec2809c13.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed UI stretching issue for Liu Yalin.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display issue for collection items on the phone.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where unlocked texting images weren't showing in the phone collection.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated missing texting images for Qin Yilin.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Liu Yalin appeared on the minimap, but her room didn’t show up in the area.[/p][/*][*][p]Previously, if you completed a level but hadn’t finished the task, the next task wouldn’t allow claiming the reward right away (you had to wait until the next session). notes.title: 🥹Release Delayed — A Heartfelt Apology & a Small Gift for our beloved community
notes.content: [h3][b][u]New Release Date[/u][/b]: [b]4:00 AM, 18 July (Pacific Time)[/b][/h3][p]—just a little longer, but we promise it will be worth the wait.[/p][p][/p][p]———[/p][h3][b]🤗 To Our Wonderful Community,[/b][/h3][p]We’re truly sorry for the delay in releasing [i]Love n Life: Happy Student[/i]. Over the past weeks, we’ve received so many messages from you saying how long you’ve been waiting for the release, and we’re deeply grateful for that anticipation and support. Your patience, encouragement, and trust mean the world to us—they inspire us every day to make our games better and more polished.[/p][p]We are deeply grateful for the incredible support from our beta testing group, who are loyal members of our community. They have worked diligently throughout the beta phase, sharing creative ideas and providing valuable feedback.[/p][p]The great news is that our beta testers have given high praise to the refined gameplay mechanics and enhanced graphics in [i]Love n Life: Happy Student[/i], highlighting them as major improvements over our previous titles. However, there are still some bugs that need to be addressed to make your first experience as smooth and enjoyable as possible.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/d85d555fe027cff1653d57654c4fffd94fff455c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]❓Why the Delay?[/b][/h3][p]Compared to our previous games, [i]Love n Life: Happy Student[/i] has a much larger scope—more story branches, more CGs, more events, and more… well, everything.[/p][p]That means:[/p][p]• A huge script size with complex multilingual syncing.[/p][p]• A few remaining bugs that might frustrate early players.[/p][p]• The user experience still needs improvement to ensure it doesn’t impact gameplay.[/p][p]• Helpful feedback from beta testers gave us a list of usability improvements we’d love to implement before release.[/p][p]🥹 Although our team has been working 12+ hours a day to test and polish everything, the workload has been heavier than expected, with some changes and challenges beyond our control.[/p][p]✨ On the bright side, our art team has used this extra time to create even more beautiful illustrations for you to enjoy in the final game![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎁 A Small Gift While You Wait[/b][/h3][p]To express our gratitude and hopefully brighten your wait, we’re sharing an exclusive, high-resolution illustration of one of the heroines. Feel free to download it, set it as your wallpaper, or simply keep it as a token of our appreciation.[/p][p]➡️ [url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1pJiqcCRn2oo1OylcDJ9qUEbUXBa9YAxl?usp=sharing"]Happy Teacher's Wallpapers[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and unwavering support. We can’t wait to share the finished game with you! [/p][p][/p][p]With love 💕,[/p][p]Reborn Entertainment Team.[/p][p][/p][p]🎯 [b]Wishlist [i]Love n Life: Happy Student[/i][/b] now if you haven’t already![/p][p]🗓️ Mark your calendar for [b]4:00 AM, July 18th (Pacific time)[/b], you won’t want to miss your next study session with these irresistible ladies and the Big Discount of 30%.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3149980/Love_n_Life_Happy_Student/"][/dynamiclink]Join the vibrant Reborn community on [url="https://discord.com/invite/zHrRdQDYfn"]Discord[/url], connect with other players, share your ideas, and become part of our growing community. notes.title: 💖 A Heartfelt Update from the Reborn Team 💖
notes.content: [p]Hey Talented Students![/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to share that Love n Life: Happy Student is now in its final stretch! Our whole team is working tirelessly on the last crucial steps, QA, bug fixes, and polishing every detail, to make sure you get the best possible experience.[/p][p][/p][p]We faced some tough times and delays during Lucky Teacher's release, but your support has kept us going. The wait is over! With just a few clicks, you can be among the first to meet the newest ladies. Dive in and explore now!


[h3]Item Management System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Item Placement: This is the core mechanic of Combat. You need to place items into designated slots to prepare for Socializing.
[*] Star-Link System: Some special items have gray stars around them. When you place items of the same type next to each other, you activate the star’s buff, boosting the item’s power and stats.
[*] Item Merge: This feature allows you to combine two items into a brand-new, higher-rarity item with superior stats.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/4e10f997609a3de689023d7849de6decc5db06bd.gif[/img]
Every choice you make shapes their lives. Are you ready to meet the characters who will change yours?

When we design a character, especially one who will be your companion for a long journey, we pour our hearts and souls into every detail. From countless sketches to endless hours of refinement, we work closely with our VIP community to uncover the perfect faces that bring these characters to life. When it comes to their physiques and color palettes, our aim is clear: the moment you see them, their posture and the spark in their eyes should tell you everything about their style and personality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/e3073717cd26942f48fd4c8167e8e6dcbda770aa.jpg[/img]


When it comes to environments, we combine advanced tools with architectural expertise and thoughtful design to craft spaces that feel both logical and deeply immersive. Our goal is to draw you into a world where every detail makes sense and enhances your experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/f2e3af58bb163189f95e0092ab53ba89626fb5ef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/c126ba8c2b3b86bcd4977886c2ee2869c9ab6361.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/1bac5150bd9c1c0188bd00d238365fd468d2f6cb.png[/img]

[h3]Liu Yating[/h3]
After the rain comes the sunshine, and Yating embodies the perfect example of life's unstoppable energy. Carefree, vibrant, and overflowing with positivity, her optimism helps her rise above any negativity life throws her way.

Her design reflects this youthful dynamism, with bright colors that highlight her gentle femininity and irresistible charm. Imagine having a beautiful, lively classmate who also happens to share your dorm. What could be more heartwarming and relatable?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/49255f5768fa4c2c24a9f35d19a82900a031b2d0.jpg[/img]


[h3]Chen Meiling[/h3]
"A man’s true potential lies in what he can achieve tomorrow." 
As a literature professor, Meiling holds the key to mastering the balance of life. She’s a caring and compassionate guide, always looking out for those she values. As both your dorm supervisor and a nurturing mentor, Meiling ensures every lesson is heartfelt. Whether it’s her guidance or the unexpected moments you’ll share in the dorm.

Her design blends a classic elegance with a youthful vibrancy. Does that sound like a contradiction? Discover more in Love n Life: Happy Student.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/31a2930d83c97f7a3efbdf11f8a07e0c10173256.jpg[/img]


[h3]Qin Yilin[/h3]
When it comes to challenges, Yilin is the embodiment of discipline and determination. In academics, she has to be at the top. In every activity, she commands the game. The armband she wears isn’t just for show. It’s a symbol of the drive forged by her childhood and past experiences, which will undoubtedly surprise you. Stay tuned to learn more about Yilin’s story.

Yilin’s design exudes power and pride, balanced with elegance, discipline, and strength. You’ll be the one to uncover the events that shaped her into the formidable person she is today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/4e7f33b1fafd9a1e7609f8ee35cb5b713556f826.jpg[/img]


[h3]Luna-3X[/h3]
Your ultimate virtual assistant and so much more. She’s not just here to help you adapt and excel in your studies. She’s your go-to confidante, a cheerful companion, and even a quirky maid-slash-digital-girlfriend! Funny, kind, and completely drama-free (yes, no jealousy here), Luna-3X will even teach you how to win the ladies’ hearts. Her carefree nature puts her a step above Yating when it comes to lighthearted fun. Luna-3X guarantees laugh-out-loud moments and takes your relaxation to the next level. Just make sure you don’t accidentally turn her off!

Her cyberpunk-inspired design blends futuristic aesthetics with sleek modern vibes, delivering an experience that feels truly ahead of its time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/fa4962cf48ffd1212b449cb637c75d777c8e4986.jpg[/img]

Because you deserve even more, we’re excited to share a glimpse of some of the side characters you’ll meet in the game. Here are their sketches. Curious about their stories? Dive into Love n Life: Happy Student to find out more later!

It’s been 7 days since the release of Love n Life: Lucky Teacher - Light of a New Day and we’ve received so much support from all of you. Not only have many people purchased both the DLC and the base game, but we've also received valuable feedback, bug reports, and a lot of interest in our team. Although our resources are limited, the key members of our development team have been going through all the suggestions and feedback from you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445340/Love_n_Life_Lucky_Teacher/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216840/Love_n_Life_Lucky_Teacher__Light_of_a_New_Day/

There have been many positive contributions along the way, and we've seen a significant improvement from the early versions to the current one, receiving a lot of praise from the community. Of course, we've also received some constructive feedback, particularly from people who gave up after not making it past the first 30 minutes of the game. This feedback made us realize some shortcomings in the early game design. However, Please know that the game becomes truly engaging once features, characters, locations, items, and more are unlocked.

We’re committed to ensuring that this design limitation won’t occur in our future projects. Please continue to support us, and if you encounter bugs, we would greatly appreciate it if you could send us the save files, logs, or screenshots with the version number. This will make it much easier for our dev team to investigate and fix the issues.

[h3]Today’s Hotfix 3.2.2:[/h3]
Fixed an issue where the DLC interfered with the nurse girl, causing her to disappear from the supermarket if the DLC was not installed.

[h3]What’s next?[/h3]
There will be an update with new outfits for the three girls: Rina, the secretary, and the farmer girl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/ca9c7908d9642468d46f41e580f5350d2cf0a3d0.jpg[/img]

We’re also adding Trading Cards and various items for the point shop, like animated backgrounds, avatars, and emotes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/315d22a1054aa249fa5058e3b57ea694173f95a5.jpg[/img]

With our mission of creating "the game that the community truly needs," we encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts, feedback, and suggestions with us. We truly appreciate it. Our team will continue working on improving the Lucky Teacher project while also preparing for the sequel, Love n Life: Happy Student.

notes.title: Love n Life: Happy Student - Craft Timeless Memories, Ignite the Flames of Romance
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/b8e1419a2bd4b7c762f8bdcab68ddff973033537.gif[/img]

At Reborn Entertainment, creativity drives everything we do as we’re committed to delivering fresh experiences. For us, fun isn’t just a goal—it’s the rule. Incorporating the Inventory Management system in Love n Life: Happy Student will bring the excitement of dating to life in a way you’ve never seen before.

Love n Life: Happy Student not only builds upon the best aspects of its predecessor but also introduces groundbreaking features in its gameplay. Our new ladies’ stories and designs are even more meticulously crafted to evoke wonderful feelings, allowing you to immerse yourself in remarkable romantic experiences fully. Thanks to your love and support for our past and current games, we've brought in additional artists, including a lead art designer, who has elevated the visual quality to new heights.

Join us and explore the new exciting features and stunning visuals of our charming ladies!

[h1]About the game:[/h1]
You're a third-year college student living in the suburbs. After taking a competitive exam, you’re lucky enough to transfer to the prestigious Lingyun University, an elite school reserved for the best of the best. Upon arrival, you’re placed in an old dorm, where your exciting new student life begins.

You'll interact with various girls, each with her own personality and preferences. The innovative inventory management system adds a fresh twist to the dating sim genre, where the items you collect and manage can influence your relationships and interactions. Balance your time, resources, and decisions to create meaningful connections and explore multiple story paths.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/d47c6ced028061498fa6e312decf0beb720bd6c3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Experience dating through the unique Inventory Management system!
[*] Give presentations, read books, play basketball, and engage in charity work in Daily Activities.
[*] Try your hand at fishing and cooking in mini-games.
[*] Complete Girls’ Missions and Side Missions.
[*] Beautiful girls come to life with Live2D animations.
[*] Choose your words carefully—your choices affect affection levels with Dynamic Conversations.
[*] Stay connected with social apps, texting, collections, and more using your phone.
[*] And other fund and interesting features.
[/list]

[h1]Liu Yating[/h1]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/65c845c6333f8d3ceb17e07c8676f6f1eabe240e.jpg[/img]
You're in the same class as a beautiful, carefree girl who loves to explore new things. She’s destined to become your best friend.

[h1]Qin Yilin[/h1]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/30fc48ed6a4a1f3fb12eb72c9c6a1e3a51f7091c.jpg[/img]
"Only knowledge and discipline create elite students. Without them, you're dust." The Student Council President is cool, elegant, and well-organized. She’s determined to push every student to reach their highest potential—no matter what it takes!

[h1]Chen Meiling[/h1]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/f690c7710964ff02f7245b9de4c737ac6e466dd8.png[/img]
The literature teacher at your school and the dorm manager where you live. With her sweet, kind, and playful personality, she’s the teacher every student loves having in class!

As an indie developer team without outside investment, your support directly fuels our ability to bring Love n Life: Warlord by Chance II to life with the full vision and scale we’ve always dreamed of. Together, we can create the ultimate experience for you
